'''Agent Meldo''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] on [[Quesh]]. He recruited a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to help him to extract a defecting Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Orlian]].
